meta.title: Implement terrain patches for improved GPU performance
meta.body_summary: Add automatic terrain patching system to subdivide large terrains into 64x64 vertex patches for per-patch frustum culling, aiming to reduce GPU load and enable proximity debug drawing.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot implemented terrain patches with per-patch frustum culling; maintainer requested multiple style and approach fixes; closed with 'Going to reroll' after final iteration, indicating design mismatch.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 326 changed lines across 3 files (nearly all in Renderer3d.fs), this is a moderate-sized change. As a GPU rendering optimization, it was closed after review iterations without merge, indicating the changes did not meet maintainer expectations for design or approach despite being moderate in scale.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer bryanedds requested three iterations: (1) implement frustum culling, (2) move new case to end for diff readability, (3) outdent utilization marking to avoid duplication. After all were addressed, PR was closed with 'Going to reroll.', suggesting the overall approach or integration was not viable.
review_details.performance_claim: Automatic terrain patching with per-patch frustum culling reduces GPU load and enables height map debugging.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR after multiple review iterations with comment 'Going to reroll.' indicating design mismatch.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Complex rendering pipeline optimization in a game engine requires deep understanding of the engine's design patterns and rendering lifecycle; the agent required multiple rounds of guidance and still did not produce acceptable implementation.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer reviewed the patch implementation, identified missing frustum culling TODO, requested code style changes, and ultimately closed the PR for a reroll.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes validation instructions for feature behavior, but no performance measurement steps or benchmarks.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After three rounds of requested changes, the PR was closed without merge; maintainer plans to reroll the implementation separately.

core_change_summary.description: Added TerrainPatch type and calculateTerrainPatches function; extended TerrainGeometryDescriptor with PatchOpt; modified categorizeTerrain in Renderer3d.fs to subdivide large terrains into patches, create patch geometries, and perform per-patch frustum culling; added TerrainPatchSize constant in Constants.fs.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Constants.fs only added a constant; Build.Linux.Debug.sh had zero changes.
change_trajectory: Added terrain patch data structures and rendering support.
Completed implementation with documentation and validation.
Implemented per-patch frustum culling per maintainer request.
Reordered pattern match cases for better diff readability.
Outdented geometry utilization marking to avoid duplication.
